name: Monument de la Renaissance africaine
subtitle: A 49-metre bronze statue in Dakar, unveiled on 3 April 2010 and meant to symbolise the triumph of African liberation.

parts.text: A 49-metre bronze statue in Dakar, unveiled on 3 April 2010 and meant to symbolise the triumph of African liberation. Some sources give a different height of 52 metres.
